text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...No way...

Shaking off her doubts, Still in Love ran 
a magnificent race. Yet, agitation is 
visible on her face. The reason is most 
likely—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No way...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's the best one... yet. Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alvvvvv!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You did great! Without rushing, you 
brought out your true strengths!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You really are strong. And you can grow 
even further—I'm so glad!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's so warm.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Right now, I...—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san...! Thank you so very 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't deny it anymore. Because it's 
right here, without a doubt."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I won't hesitate anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind, too. I won't 
hesitate anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: And yet, why are you— hesitating?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That intensity. ...I didn't feel it 
today."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did you become complacent after winning 
the Triple Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Too bad. Just when the real part was 
about to start.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your glory... I will rewrite it with my 
own name.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Alve-san's raw, naked fighting spirit... 
It's piercing right through to my skin, 
and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel anything... My heart... isn't 
stirred at all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Why...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Are you feeling completely 
fulfilled...?

Still in Love returned with a perplexed 
expression. After hesitating for a 
moment—she opened her mouth to speak.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —It seems my instincts have vanished.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, ever since the Shuka Sho... 
I haven't been able to feel her presence 
at all..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That hunger for racing that was always 
clinging to me... Now, it's finally...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. There's only one 
thing... I can say—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It means... that I won't ever be able to 
run like that again.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Without her strength, I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Maybe... I won't ever be 
able to show you a victory again..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T h a n k s f o r t h e m e a l !!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufufufu...!! Give it to meeeeee, all 
of iiiit!!!!

That beautiful figure, running with raw 
instinct laid bare...

I will never see it again. ...A sense of 
loss weighs heavy on my chest.
...Even so.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list:
You've been struggling with it for so 
long, after all.

You've been struggling with it for so 
long, haven't you?

text_block_list.text:
"Though the power of her instincts led to 
victory, it is also true that it had 
caused her suffering until now."

"It's such a pity we won't see it 
anymore"... I couldn't bring myself to say 
that for the life of me. And above all 
else...
choice_data_list:
Your happiness... is what matters most to 
me.
Your happiness... is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Let's keep looking for ways to get 
stronger without relying on instinct.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Still in Love casts her eyes downward. 
Seeing her reaction— something immediately 
crossed my mind.
choice_data_list:
Could it be... you don't even feel like 
running?

text_block_list.text:
Girls who, all of a sudden, lose their 
will to run. To take on a race, you need 
at least some degree of fighting spirit. 
Those who cannot recover it are—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Because, I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I still haven't... to you...
choice_data_list:
...Shall we set aside some time for you to 
rest?

text_block_list.text:
We probably won't find the answer right 
away for what to do next. We should take a 
proper rest over the New Year's holidays 
and—
choice_data_list:
Let's kick off senior year with the Kinko 
Sho!

text_block_list.text:
"The Kinko Sho is a 2000m GII race held at 
Chukyo Racecourse. By the first half of 
March, her feelings should be settled."
choice_data_list: Think it over carefully until then.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...
